description:
The base for everything served through AWS Bedrock, on the AWS SDK alone: the Converse
        client (every vendor Bedrock serves, Claude included), Cohere embeddings, the shared AWS
        credential and transport wiring, the account's model listings, and the Bedrock-only and
        zero-retention pickers. Carries the catalog fragment of the models it serves. A client
        family with an SDK of its own adds to this artifact rather than living in it: the
        Anthropic-on-Bedrock and Mantle clients are nucleo-provider-bedrock-anthropic. Ships on
        AWS's cadence.
